events.name: Bash
events.head: Check masterclass source and live mirror for banned figures
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn '\$50M\|Cavli\|Appster\|Coinfirm\|webinar' app/src/app/masterclass/page.tsx app/src/app/masterclass/masterclass-client.tsx | head; echo ---; grep -n 'Price\|prices\|cohort\|checkout' app/src/app/masterclass/masterclass-client.tsx | head -15; echo ---; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/mc.html; wc -c /tmp/mc.html; grep -o '\$50M[^<]*' /tmp/mc.html | head -3; grep -o -i 'webinar' /tmp/mc.html | wc -l; grep -o '\$99' /tmp/mc.html | head -2; grep -c '[–—]' /tmp/mc.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-funnels against the mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site PREFIX=/ timeout 500 node scripts/probe-funnels.mjs 2>&1 | tail -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-funnels on mirror; show webinar contexts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site PREFIX=/ node scripts/probe-funnels.mjs 2>&1 | tail -25; grep -o -i '.\{60\}webinar.\{40\}' /tmp/mc.html | head -9

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find which meta tags carry webinar
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -o '<meta[^>]*webinar[^>]*>' /tmp/mc.html | cut -c1-200; grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/mc.html; grep -o '<meta name="description"[^>]*>' /tmp/mc.html | cut -c1-250; grep -rln 'webinar attribution built in' src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read masterclass metadata file
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; cat src/app/masterclass/page.tsx; grep -n 'openGraph\|twitter' src/app/workshop/page.tsx | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read root layout openGraph metadata
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n -A12 'openGraph' src/app/layout.tsx | head -40; grep -n -A8 'twitter:' src/app/layout.tsx | head -12

events.text: The live /masterclass page uses the sitewide share description, which says "webinar". That breaks the rule against "webinar" on masterclass pages. I'm adding page-level share metadata to fix it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for a running local dev server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for p in 3000 3001 3100; do printf "$p "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -m 5 localhost:$p/masterclass; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server and check share meta tags
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (npx next dev -p 3917 > /tmp/t001-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t001-dev.pid); for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -m 60 localhost:3917/masterclass -o /tmp/mcl.html && break; sleep 2; done; grep -o '<meta[^>]*\(og:\|twitter:\)\(title\|description\|url\)[^>]*>' /tmp/mcl.html | cut -c1-160; grep -o -i 'webinar attribution' /tmp/mcl.html | wc -l
